title: Design: A/R Detail at 1440 px in light theme looks as described
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has a long name (more than 40 characters) and open documents at both locations on today's date, including a credit memo.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-04 Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment and Trailer Repair.
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom, with every group expanded (Expand all).
  • Sales By Customer (Reports, then "Sales By Customer" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu) is open in a second tab of the same window, for comparison.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the title row.
  2. Look at where the filter row sits, and compare with Sales By Customer.
  3. Read the column headings left to right, letter for letter, capitals included.
  4. Look for a sideways scroll bar under the table.
  5. Look at {Customer-A}'s rows: the name and Transaction type cells, and the money, date and number cells.
  6. Look across the whole page for any text that overlaps, is cut off or is clipped.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the title, its info icon directly right of it, and the ⋯ Export button at the right end, all on one line.
  • Step 2: the filter row sits below the title row, in the same place as on Sales By Customer.
  • Step 3: "Date", "Location", "Transaction type", "ID", "Customer full name", "Due date", "Amount", "Open balance" ("Location" shown because two locations are in view; it sits right after "Date"). No heading wraps.
  • Step 4: there is none: every column is visible at 1440 px without scrolling sideways.
  • Step 5: the long name and a long Transaction type wrap onto a second line; money, date and number cells stay on one line, and Location does not wrap.
  • Step 6: nothing overlaps, is cut off or clipped.

The PRD writes "Open balance", "Due date" and "Transaction type" for this report (S2-R1) but "Open Balance" in its Terminology; which letter case is right is question 4.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header), story SV-11536 (Story 6, Location column), story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S8-R2: “The title, its info icon and the Export menu stay on one line at 1440 pixels wide; the filter row sits below them, positioned as on the native reports.”
  • S8-R3: “The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is pinned to the right edge and bold on the header, every row, every expanded row and the Totals row, as on Sales By Customer. At 1440 pixels wide every column of all six reports is visible without scrolling sideways: the customer or vendor name and Transaction type wrap long values onto a second line, Location wraps only on A/P Detail (nine columns), column headings never wrap, and money, date and number columns never wrap. Narrower than 1440 pixels, the table scrolls sideways under the pinned column.”
  • S2-R1, A/R Detail columns: “A/R Detail: Date, Location (when shown), Transaction type, ID, Customer full name, Due date, Amount, Open balance.”
  • S6-R3: “It sits right after the Date column, before the money columns; on A/R Summary and A/P Summary, which have no Date column, right after the customer or vendor name.”
  • Key Decisions, reuse rule: “The reuse rule. Every control on these reports reuses an existing ShopView pattern: the native filter chips, the native totals row and pinned headline column of the newer reports, the existing location-switch prompt, the design system's chevron icon. Nothing new is drawn. Basis: d-reuse-existing-pattern.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html); page 5 "Document links and Switch location" (board Links.dc.html); page 6 "Descriptions and pinned column" (board Layout.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p4-opens-on-all-locations.png: figure "Opens on All locations" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"
  • ar-ap-p5-links-only-where-they-can-open.png: figure "Links only where they can open" (This build (after)), board "5. Document links and Switch location (SV-5706)"
  • ar-ap-p6-a-p-detail-scrolled-sideways-light.png: figure "A/P Detail scrolled sideways, light" (Production (before)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "Native filter row: As of, Customer, Past due, then Location, which opens on "Location: All locations". Untouched, the report matches today. Column labelled "Location", after Date. S5-R1, S5-R2, S5-R5, S6-R1 to S6-R3." (caption of "Opens on All locations")
  • "A number links only with the right permission and a location the user works at; otherwise plain text. Native link style. S7-R1, S7-R2, S7-R6, S7-R7, S7-N1, S7-N2." (caption of "Links only where they can open")
  • "No description anywhere; no column stays in place." (caption of "A/P Detail scrolled sideways, light")

Difference from the PRD (DD-06): the PRD says A/R Detail and A/R Collection headings written "Transaction type", "Customer full name", "Due date", "Past due", "Open balance" (S2-R1); the design shows the after pictures read "Transaction Type", "Customer Full Name", "Due Date", "Past Due", "Open Balance"; today's production pictures already read the same, with "Location Full Name". This case follows the PRD; the difference is question 4 on Chris Ward's sheet (sent 22 Oct 2026); the design version is held in D-81.
